$comment: Single source of truth for the Google Cloud icon pack used by Mermaid (prefix `gcp`). Regenerate the pack with `node scripts/build-gcp-icon-pack.mjs`. Google's own product→icon equivalence (May 2026 guide) is the authority: core products get a unique icon, every other product gets its category icon. Entries with source=extension are products Google's guide omits; they are mapped by this project to the closest official category icon and must be reviewed when Google updates the guide.

summary: The Google Cloud icons are trademarks and brand features of Google LLC. They are not covered by this project's Apache-2.0 licence.
You may use them only to depict Google Cloud products in architecture diagrams.
Do not recolour, distort, crop or restyle them, and do not use them as a logo or outside diagrams.
Do not present them in a way that implies Google's endorsement, sponsorship or affiliation.
Label nodes with the official Google Cloud product names.
Google's own terms and trademark guidelines, at the link below, prevail over this summary.

notice.editor: Google Cloud and the Google Cloud product icons are trademarks of Google LLC, used here solely to depict Google Cloud products in architecture diagrams.
notice.editorAfter: Icons are used unmodified, as published by Google.
notice.export: Google Cloud and the Google Cloud product icons are trademarks of Google LLC, used unmodified solely to depict Google Cloud products in this architecture diagram.

legacy.note: Google: 'these icons should not be used as of 2026'. Kept only for the `legacy` cross-reference field and an opt-in `gcp-legacy` pack for migrating old diagrams.

icons.name: Vertex AI
icons.note: Shipped in core-products-icons.zip but absent from the May-2026 guide's core list.

icons.name: Web and Mobile
icons.note: Category icon exists in the ZIP; the guide lists no products under it.

products.name: Customer Engagement Suite
products.note: The guide lists it under both 'AI Applications & Agents' and 'AI and Machine Learning'; the more specific category is used.

products.name: Agent Assist
products.note: Also listed under 'AI and Machine Learning' in the guide.

products.name: Cloud Optimization AI Fleet Routing API
Vertex AI
products.note: Unique icon shipped in core-products-icons.zip; not listed in the guide.

products.name: Gemini (Code Assist, Enterprise, etc.)
products.note: Marked core in the guide, but NO Gemini icon is distributed in the icon ZIPs and the Gemini mark has its own brand guidelines — never improvise the Gemini logo. Category icon used as the sanctioned fallback.

products.name: Looker Studio
products.note: Marked core in the guide; no dedicated file shipped, defaults to the Looker core icon.

products.name: Looker Studio Pro
products.note: Marked core in the guide; no dedicated file shipped, defaults to the Looker core icon.

products.name: Google Workspace
products.note: Google Workspace has its own brand program; the Collaboration category icon is the only option inside the Google Cloud icon set.

products.name: GKE Enterprise
products.note: GKE Enterprise is the Anthos successor; the guide still lists Anthos as the core product, so the Anthos icon is used.

products.name: Data Loss Prevention API
products.note: Now branded Sensitive Data Protection; the guide places it under Data Analytics (not Security).

products.name: SQL
products.note: Listed verbatim as 'SQL' in the guide. Most diagrams mean Cloud SQL — prefer gcp:cloud-sql.

products.name: Container Registry
products.note: Deprecated in favor of Artifact Registry.

products.name: Resource Manager
products.note: No icon exists for project/folder/organization in the 2025 system. For diagram boundaries prefer a plain `group` with a label (see guide).

products.name: Earth Engine
products.note: Marked core in the guide but no unique icon is shipped; category icon used.

products.name: Google Maps Platform
products.note: Marked core in the guide but no unique icon is shipped; Google Maps marks have separate brand guidelines. Category icon used.

products.name: Migrate for Compute Engine
products.note: Superseded by Migrate to Virtual Machines (Compute category).

products.name: Managed Service for Microsoft Active Directory
Hyperdisk
products.note: Core page lists Hyperdisk '(previously Persistent Disk)'; the Storage category page lists it without the core marker. The unique icon exists in the ZIP, so it is treated as core.

products.name: Persistent Disk
products.note: Mapped to the Hyperdisk core icon per the guide's '(previously Persistent Disk)' note. Use gcp:storage if you want the generic category icon instead.

excluded.name: Google Cloud (platform logo)
excluded.reason: The Google Cloud logo is a brand feature outside the product icon set; Google's trademark guidelines restrict logo use to approved partners. Use an unlabeled `group` or the Mermaid default `cloud` icon for the platform boundary.

excluded.name: Firebase
excluded.reason: Separate brand program with its own icons/guidelines; not part of the Google Cloud icon set.

excluded.name: Gemini logo
excluded.reason: Gemini marks are governed by separate brand guidelines; no icon is shipped in the Google Cloud ZIPs (see the `gemini` product entry fallback).

excluded.name: Google Maps / Google Workspace logos
excluded.reason: Separate brand programs; only the category icon is available within this set.
